title: (RHBA-2018:0345) Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 3.6 Jenkins Image Release Advisory
portal_summary: An updated Jenkins container image, which has been rebuilt using the latest base images, is now available for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 3.6.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 3.6 Jenkins Image Release Advisory
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.6|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, ensure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For instructions on new installations, see the following documentation:

https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/3.6/install_config/install/planning.html

For instructions on how to properly upgrade existing clusters to OpenShift
Container Platform 3.6, see the following documentation:

https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/3.6/install_config/upgrading/index.html
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform is the company's cloud computing Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution designed for on-premise or private cloud deployments.

Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform provides a container image for running Jenkins. This image provides a Jenkins server instance, which can be used to set up a basic flow for continuous testing, integration, and delivery.

This update includes the following image:

openshift3/jenkins-2-rhel7:v3.6.173.0.96-11

All OpenShift Container Platform 3.6 users are advised to upgrade to this updated image.
